6. Tell the player in a few warm, concrete sentences what you built, how to play it, how the AI behaves, and that they can play-test it and publish it from the Forge screen. For changes they ask for later, change the same project, bump the version in game.json and submit again.

assets.app/forge.py:
"""The Game Forge: people describe a game, chat with the Forge agent (the
custom agent the workflow made in the platform's Aseman space), and the agent
builds it — a Godot 4.3 project on the space's computer, tested, exported and
submitted to the Arena with tools/arena_forge.py. The person play-tests it in
their garage and publishes it to the store.

This module writes the agent's brief, talks to it through the developer API
(POST {api}/platform/spaces/ask, as the key's person, in the project's own
thread of the Forge room when the node allows one, else in temporary
threads with the conversation in the brief) and reads its replies.
"""

import json
import urllib.error
import urllib.request

GAME_CONTRACT = """\
Every Arena game is a Godot 4.3 project, single-player against AI opponents (no networking, no other humans):
- Folder: /workspace/forge/{pid}/project — project.godot (config/features "4.3", renderer gl_compatibility,
  rendering/textures/vram_compression/import_etc2_astc=true), export_presets.cfg (a "Web" preset, thread_support=false),
  game.json (the store manifest) and everything else under arena/<slug_underscored>/ (res:// paths there), tests under tests/.
- The main scene's root script declares `signal arena_event(json: String)` and the methods
  `arena_start(params: Dictionary)`, `arena_stop()` and `arena_state() -> Dictionary`.
  It emits JSON events: {"type":"ready"} when loaded, {"type":"started"} when a match starts, and exactly one
  {"type":"result","game":"<slug>","outcome":"win|loss|draw","score":<int ≥ 0>,"duration_s":<int>, …game stats} when it ends.
  When it is the main scene (a Web build) it starts itself from the page's query string.
- It is mounted as a resource pack inside another Godot world: no autoloads, no class_name (use preload), input actions
  added in code with InputMap, no project-setting assumptions; touch controls as well as keyboard/mouse.
- AI opponents: real decision making (search, state machines, utility AI, pathfinding), with difficulty levels in params.
- Models: CC0 only (Poly Haven, Kenney, Quaternius) fetched at build time with
  python3 /workspace/apps/{app}/games/fetch_assets.py style manifests, or procedural meshes; record licences in game.json "credits".
- game.json: slug, title (≤ 40), version, tagline, description, genre, tags, mode "single-player vs AI",
  players {"humans": 1, "ai": <n or text>}, engine "godot-4.3", scene "res://arena/<…>/main.tscn",
  pack "<slug>.pck", web "web/index.html", accent, settings (the params a room can set), scoring, controls, credits.
- Headless tests in tests/run_tests.gd (extends SceneTree, prints "<slug>-tests passed" and quits 0) that start a
  match, drive it and check the result event.
"""

SUBMIT = """\
When the game works, submit it (it validates the manifest and the scene contract, runs the tests headless,
exports the pack and the Web build, and hands the build to the Arena):
  python3 /workspace/apps/{app}/tools/arena_forge.py submit --project {pid} --dir /workspace/forge/{pid}/project
It prints "forge-submitted <slug> <version>" or what to fix. Fix and submit again until it is accepted.
"""


class ForgeError(Exception):
    pass


def brief(project, history, message, app_slug):
    """What the Forge agent is asked for one message of the conversation."""
    pid = project["id"]
    lines = [
        "You are building a game for a person on Aseman Arena, in the Game Forge.",
        "Project %s — \"%s\" (%s). Status: %s." % (pid, project["title"], project.get("genre") or "any genre", project["status"]),
        "The person's brief: " + project["brief"],
        "",
        GAME_CONTRACT.replace("{pid}", pid).replace("{app}", app_slug),
        SUBMIT.replace("{pid}", pid).replace("{app}", app_slug),
        "Work in /workspace/forge/%s. Talk with the person like a senior game designer: ask what matters when the brief is"
        " unclear, propose a design (core loop, the AI opponents and how they decide, controls, look, scoring), then build"
        " it, test it, submit it, and tell them what you made and how to play it. Keep replies short and concrete." % pid,
    ]
    if history:
        lines.append("")
        lines.append("The conversation so far (oldest first):")
        for m in history[-16:]:
            who = "Person" if m["role"] == "user" else "You"
            lines.append("%s: %s" % (who, m["text"][:1500]))
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("The person now says: " + message)
    return "\n".join(lines)


class Client:
    """The developer API's platform door, as the server key's person."""

    def __init__(self, api_url, key, space, bot, room="", timeout=1800):
        self.api_url = (api_url or "").rstrip("/")
        self.key, self.space, self.bot, self.room, self.timeout = key, space, bot, room, timeout

    @property
    def ready(self):
        return bool(self.api_url and self.key and self.space and self.bot)

    def _post(self, path, payload, timeout=None):
        req = urllib.request.Request(self.api_url + path, data=json.dumps(payload).encode(), method="POST",
                                     headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + self.key, "Content-Type": "application/json"})
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout or self.timeout) as r:
                return json.loads(r.read().decode() or "{}")
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
            raise ForgeError("the Forge agent could not be reached (%s): %s" % (e.code, e.read().decode(errors="replace")[:300]))
        except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, OSError) as e:
            raise ForgeError("the Forge agent could not be reached: %s" % e)

    def open_thread(self, title):
        """A thread of the Forge room for one project, or "" when this node
        or key cannot open one (asks then run in temporary threads)."""
        if not self.room:
            return ""
        try:
            out = self._post("/platform/spaces/thread_create", {"room": self.room, "title": title[:80]}, timeout=30)
        except ForgeError:
            return ""
        t = out.get("thread") if isinstance(out.get("thread"), dict) else out
        return str((t or {}).get("id") or "")

    def ask(self, body, thread=""):
        payload = {"space": self.space, "bot": self.bot, "body": body}
        if thread:
            payload["thread"] = thread
        else:
            payload["temp_thread"] = True
            if self.room:
                payload["room"] = self.room
        out = self._post("/platform/spaces/ask", payload)
        reply = out.get("reply")
        if not reply:
            raise ForgeError("the Forge agent gave no reply")
        return str(reply)

def read_env_file(path):
    out = {}
    try:
        with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
            for line in f:
                line = line.strip()
                if line and not line.startswith("#") and "=" in line:
                    k, v = line.split("=", 1)
                    out[k.strip()] = v.strip().strip('"')
    except OSError:
        pass
    return out

class RateLimit:
    def __init__(self, per, window):
        self.per, self.window, self.hits, self.lock = per, window, {}, threading.Lock()

    def ok(self, key):
        t = time.time()
        with self.lock:
            hist = [x for x in self.hits.get(key, []) if t - x < self.window]
            if len(hist) >= self.per:
                self.hits[key] = hist
                return False
            hist.append(t)
            self.hits[key] = hist
            return True

    def sync_games(self):
        """Every built official game (games_dir/<slug>/game.json) is in the
        store at its built version."""
        found = []
        root = self.cfg["games_dir"]
        if os.path.isdir(root):
            for slug in sorted(os.listdir(root)):

                self.store.upsert_game(m, {"dir": os.path.join(root, slug)}, "published", "", official=True)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def launch(self, uid, game, room, choices):
        """Starts a match: the game's settings (the room's, then the
        person's choices, within the manifest's bounds) and a one-time token."""
        m = game["manifest"]
        settings = {}
        for key, spec in (m.get("settings") or {}).items():
            v = choices.get(key, (room or {}).get("settings", {}).get(key, spec.get("default")))
            if spec.get("type") == "integer":
                try:
                    v = int(v)
                except (TypeError, ValueError):
                    v = spec.get("default")
                v = max(spec.get("min", v), min(spec.get("max", v), v))
            elif spec.get("type") == "enum" and v not in spec.get("values", []):
                v = spec.get("default")
            settings[key] = v
        match = self.store.start_match(uid, game["slug"], room["id"] if room else "", settings)
        user = self.store.user(uid)
        params = dict(settings, player_name=user["name"], match=match["id"], token=match["token"],
                      report_url=self.asset_base() + "api/matches/%s/result" % match["id"] if self.asset_base() else "")
        view = self.game_view(game, uid)
        web = ""
        if view["launch"]["web"]:
            web = view["launch"]["web"] + "?" + "&".join("%s=%s" % (k, quote(str(v))) for k, v in params.items() if v != "")
        if room:
            self.store.post(room["id"], uid, "%s started %s" % (user["handle"], m["title"]), kind="system")
        return {"match": {"id": match["id"], "token": match["token"], "game": game["slug"], "settings": settings},
                "launch": dict(view["launch"], params=params, web=web)}

    def finish(self, mid, body):
        match = self.store.match(mid)
        need(match is not None, 404, "no such match")
        need(rnd.compare_digest(str(body.get("token", "")), match["token"]), 403, "this result is not signed by its match")
        if match["status"] != "playing":
            return {"duplicate": True, "match": self._match_out(match)}
        result = {k: v for k, v in body.items() if k != "token" and not isinstance(v, (dict, list))}
        if isinstance(body.get("pgn"), str):
            result["pgn"] = body["pgn"][:20000]
        elapsed = now() - match["started_at"]
        problems = arena.plausible(match["game"], result, elapsed)
        need(not problems, 422, "; ".join(problems))
        uid, game = match["user"], match["game"]
        outcome = result["outcome"]
        score = int(result.get("score") or 0)
        lvl = int(result.get("level") or result.get("difficulty") or match["settings"].get("level") or match["settings"].get("difficulty") or 3)
        before = self.store.rating(uid, game)
        rating = before["rating"] if before else arena.START_RATING
        new_rating = arena.elo(rating, arena.AI_RATING.get(lvl, 1400), outcome, before["games"] if before else 0)
        xp = arena.match_xp(game, result)
        self.store.finish_match(mid, result, outcome, score, xp, new_rating - rating)
        self.store.save_rating(uid, game, new_rating, score, outcome)
        user = self.store.record_result_stats(uid, outcome, xp)
        stats = {"matches": user["matches"], "wins": user["wins"], "streak": user["streak"], "rating:" + game: new_rating}
        unlocked = self.unlock(uid, arena.earned(game, result, stats))
        g = self.store.game(game)
        title = g["manifest"]["title"] if g else game
        if match["room"]:
            verb = {"win": "won", "loss": "lost", "draw": "drew"}[outcome]
            what = "vs level %d" % lvl
            self.store.post(match["room"], uid, "%s %s %s %s — %d pts%s" % (
                user["handle"], verb, title, what, score, " (%+d)" % (new_rating - rating) if new_rating != rating else ""), kind="result")
        out = self._match_out(self.store.match(mid))
        out.update({"rating": new_rating, "rating_change": new_rating - rating, "xp": xp, "progress": arena.level_progress(user["xp"]),
                    "achievements": unlocked, "rank": self.store.rank_of(uid, game)})
        return out

    def _match_out(self, m):
        return {"id": m["id"], "game": m["game"], "outcome": m["outcome"], "score": m["score"], "xp": m["xp"], "rating_change": m["rating_change"]}

    def unlock(self, uid, ids):
        got = []
        for a in ids:
            if a in arena.ACHIEVEMENTS and self.store.grant(uid, a):
                info = arena.ACHIEVEMENTS[a]
                self.store.add_xp(uid, info["xp"])
                self.store.notify(uid, "achievement", "Achievement unlocked: %s" % info["title"], {"id": a})
                got.append(dict(info, id=a))
        return got

    def social_check(self, uid):
        stats = {"friends": len(self.store.friend_ids(uid)), "rooms": self.store.rooms_hosted(uid), "published": self.store.published_by(uid)}
        return self.unlock(uid, arena.social_achievements(stats))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Profile
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def profile(self, u, viewer=None):
        out = public_user(u, full=True)
        out["ratings"] = []
        for r in self.store.ratings(u["id"]):
            g = self.store.game(r["game"])
            row = {k: v for k, v in r.items() if k != "user"}
            out["ratings"].append(dict(row, title=g["manifest"]["title"] if g else r["game"], rank=self.store.rank_of(u["id"], r["game"])))
        have = {a["id"]: a["at"] for a in self.store.achievements(u["id"])}
        out["achievements"] = [dict(info, id=k, unlocked=k in have, at=have.get(k)) for k, info in arena.ACHIEVEMENTS.items()]
        out["recent"] = self.store.recent_matches(u["id"], 8)
        out["friends"] = len(self.store.friend_ids(u["id"]))
        out["rooms"] = [self.room_view(r, viewer) for r in self.store.rooms(viewer) if r["host"] == u["id"]][:6]
        if viewer and viewer != u["id"]:
            out["friendship"] = self.store.friend_status(viewer, u["id"])
        return out

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Forge
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def forge_turn(self, pid, text):
        """Asks the Forge agent, in the background; the person sees the
        reply when it comes (the project's messages)."""
        p = self.store.project(pid)
        history = [m for m in self.store.forge_messages(pid) if m["state"] == "done"]
        self.store.forge_say(pid, "user", text)
        pending = self.store.forge_say(pid, "agent", "", state="thinking")
        if p["status"] == "drafting":
            self.store.update_project(pid, status="building")

        def work():
            try:
                if not self.client.ready:
                    raise forge.ForgeError("the Forge agent is not connected on this server")
                thread = self.threads.get(pid)
                if thread is None:
                    thread = self.client.open_thread("Forge · " + p["title"])
                    self.threads[pid] = thread
                body = forge.brief(self.store.project(pid), [] if thread else history, text, self.cfg["slug"])
                reply = self.client.ask(body, thread)
                self.store.forge_update_message(pending, reply.strip()[:20000], "done")
            except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 — shown to the person
                self.store.forge_update_message(pending, "The Forge could not answer: %s" % e, "failed")
            cur = self.store.project(pid)
            if cur and cur["status"] == "building" and not cur["build"]:
                self.store.update_project(pid, status="drafting")

        threading.Thread(target=work, daemon=True).start()
        return pending

    def forge_build(self, pid, body):
        """tools/arena_forge.py hands over a build: its manifest and folder."""
        p = self.store.project(pid)
        need(p is not None, 404, "no such project")
        m = body.get("manifest") or {}
        problems = arena.validate_manifest(m)
        need(not problems, 422, "; ".join(problems))
        folder = str(body.get("dir") or "")
        need(os.path.isfile(os.path.join(folder, m["pack"])), 422, "the build folder has no %s" % m["pack"])
        other = self.store.game(m["slug"])
        need(other is None or other["author"] == p["user"], 409, "another game already uses the slug %s" % m["slug"])
        dest = os.path.join(self.cfg["data_dir"], "forge", pid, "build", m["slug"])
        if os.path.abspath(folder) != os.path.abspath(dest):
            shutil.rmtree(dest, ignore_errors=True)
            shutil.copytree(folder, dest)
        status = "published" if other and other["status"] == "published" else "testing"
        self.store.upsert_game(m, {"dir": dest}, status, p["user"])
        self.store.update_project(pid, status="ready", slug=m["slug"], build={"version": m["version"], "at": now(), "dir": dest})
        self.store.notify(p["user"], "forge", "%s is built — play-test it, then publish it" % m["title"], {"project": pid, "game": m["slug"]})
        return {"slug": m["slug"], "status": status}

    def forge_publish(self, uid, pid):
        p = self.store.project(pid)
        need(p is not None and p["user"] == uid, 404, "no such project")
        need(p["slug"], 409, "nothing is built yet: ask the Forge to build and submit the game")
        g = self.store.game(p["slug"])
        need(g is not None, 409, "the build is missing")
        need(not arena.validate_manifest(g["manifest"]), 422, "; ".join(arena.validate_manifest(g["manifest"])))
        self.store.upsert_game(g["manifest"], g["files"], "published", uid)
        self.store.update_project(pid, status="published")
        unlocked = self.social_check(uid)
        return {"slug": p["slug"], "status": "published", "achievements": unlocked}


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# HTTP
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

def handler_for(app):
    class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"
        server_version = "AsemanArena/1.0"

        def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
            if not os.environ.get("ARENA_QUIET"):
                super().log_message(fmt, *args)

        # -- helpers ---------------------------------------------------
        def send_json(self, status, obj):
            body = json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False).encode()
            self.send_response(status)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
            self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(body)

        def send_file(self, path, cache=False):
            if not os.path.isfile(path):
                raise HTTPError(404, "not found")
            size = os.path.getsize(path)
            ctype = TYPES.get(os.path.splitext(path)[1].lower()) or mimetypes.guess_type(path)[0] or "application/octet-stream"
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", ctype)
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(size))
            self.send_header("Cache-Control", "public, max-age=31536000, immutable" if cache else "no-cache")
            self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
            self.end_headers()
            if self.command == "HEAD":
                return
            with open(path, "rb") as f:
                shutil.copyfileobj(f, self.wfile, 1 << 20)

        def _drain(self):
            """Reads the whole request body before anything else, so a route
            that ignores it never leaves it in a kept-alive connection."""
            n = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
            if n > 2_000_000:
                self.close_connection = True
                raise HTTPError(413, "request too large")
            self._raw = self.rfile.read(n) if n else b""

        def body(self):
            raw = getattr(self, "_raw", b"")
            if not raw:
                return {}
            try:
                out = json.loads(raw.decode())
            except ValueError:
                raise HTTPError(400, "the body must be JSON")
            need(isinstance(out, dict), 400, "the body must be a JSON object")
            return out

        def me(self, required=True):
            uid = (self.headers.get("X-Aseman-User") or "").strip()
            if not UID.match(uid):
                need(not required, 401, "Sign in to %s to do this" % app.cfg["product"])
                return None
            handle = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9_.-]", "", (self.headers.get("X-Aseman-User-Handle") or "").lower())[:24]
            return app.store.ensure_user(uid, handle or "player", self.headers.get("X-Aseman-User-Name") or None)

        def internal(self):
            tok = app.cfg.get("internal_token") or ""
            got = (self.headers.get("Authorization") or "").removeprefix("Bearer ").strip()
            need(tok and rnd.compare_digest(tok, got), 403, "internal")

        # -- dispatch --------------------------------------------------
        def do_GET(self):
            self.route("GET")

        def do_HEAD(self):
            self.route("GET")

        def do_POST(self):
            self.route("POST")

        def do_PUT(self):
            self.route("PUT")

        def do_PATCH(self):
            self.route("PATCH")

        def do_DELETE(self):
            self.route("DELETE")

        def route(self, method):
            u = urlparse(self.path)
            path = unquote(u.path).strip("/")
            q = {k: v[-1] for k, v in parse_qs(u.query).items()}
            try:
                self._drain()
                if path.startswith("api/") or path.startswith("internal/") or path == "healthz":
                    out = self.api(method, path, q)
                    self.send_json(200 if not isinstance(out, tuple) else out[0], out if not isinstance(out, tuple) else out[1])
                else:
                    self.files(path)
            except HTTPError as e:
                self.send_json(e.status, {"error": e.message})
            except BrokenPipeError:
                pass
            except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
                traceback.print_exc()
                self.send_json(500, {"error": "server error: %s" % e})

        def files(self, path):
            if path == "elpian/app.js":
                return self.send_file(ELPIAN)
            if path.startswith("assets/models/"):
                name = os.path.basename(path)
                return self.send_file(os.path.join(PUBLIC, "assets", "models", name), cache=True)
            m = re.match(r"^games/([a-z0-9-]+)/(.+)$", path)
            if m:
                g = app.store.game(m.group(1))
                need(g is not None and g["status"] in ("published", "testing"), 404, "no such game")
                rel = os.path.normpath(m.group(2))
                need(not rel.startswith("..") and not os.path.isabs(rel), 404, "not found")
                if rel == "icon.svg":
                    folder = app.game_dir(g)
                    icon = os.path.join(folder, "icon.svg")
                    return self.send_file(icon if os.path.isfile(icon) else os.path.join(PUBLIC, "icon.svg"), cache=False)
                return self.send_file(os.path.join(app.game_dir(g), rel), cache=rel.endswith(".pck"))
            m = re.match(r"^play/([a-z0-9-]+)$", path)
            if m:
                g = app.store.game(m.group(1))
                need(g is not None and g["status"] == "published" and g["manifest"].get("web"), 404, "no such game")
                self.send_response(302)
                self.send_header("Location", "../games/%s/%s?practice=1" % (g["slug"], g["manifest"]["web"]))
                self.send_header("Content-Length", "0")
                self.end_headers()
                return
            rel = os.path.normpath(path or "index.html")
            need(not rel.startswith(".."), 404, "not found")
            return self.send_file(os.path.join(PUBLIC, rel))

        def api(self, method, path, q):
            s = app.store
            parts = path.split("/")
            if path == "healthz":
                return {"ok": True, "agent": app.client.ready, "games": len(s.games()), "product": app.cfg["product"]}
            if parts[0] == "internal":
                self.internal()
                if path == "internal/games/sync" and method == "POST":
                    return {"games": app.sync_games()}
                if len(parts) == 4 and parts[1] == "forge" and parts[3] == "build" and method == "POST":
                    return app.forge_build(parts[2], self.body())
                raise HTTPError(404, "no such internal route")
            parts = parts[1:]
            head = parts[0] if parts else ""

            if head == "config" and method == "GET":
                me = self.me(required=False)
                return {"product": app.cfg["product"], "slug": app.cfg["slug"], "asset_base": app.asset_base(),
                        "me": public_user(me, full=True) if me else None, "signed_in": me is not None,
                        "unread": s.unread(me["id"]) if me else None, "room_themes": arena.ROOM_THEMES,
                        "garage_themes": list(arena.GARAGE_THEMES), "achievements": arena.ACHIEVEMENTS,
                        "android_apk": app.cfg.get("android_apk") or "", "forge": app.client.ready}

            # -- me, profiles, people ------------------------------------
            if head == "me":
                me = self.me()
                if method == "GET":
                    return app.profile(me, me["id"])
                if method == "PATCH":
                    b = self.body()
                    fields = {}
                    if "name" in b:
                        name = arena.clean_text(b["name"], 40)
                        need(len(name) >= 2, 400, "a name needs at least 2 characters")
                        fields["name"] = name
                    if "bio" in b:
                        fields["bio"] = arena.clean_text(b["bio"], 280)
                    if "title" in b:
                        fields["title"] = arena.clean_text(b["title"], 40)
                    if "color" in b:
                        need(arena.COLOR.match(str(b["color"])), 400, "color is #rrggbb")
                        fields["color"] = b["color"]
                    if "favorite_game" in b:
                        fields["favorite_game"] = str(b["favorite_game"])[:41]
                    s.update_user(me["id"], fields)
                    return app.profile(s.user(me["id"]), me["id"])
            if head == "profiles" and len(parts) == 2 and method == "GET":
                viewer = self.me(required=False)
                u = s.user_by_handle(parts[1])
                need(u is not None, 404, "no such player")
                return app.profile(u, viewer["id"] if viewer else None)
            if head == "users" and method == "GET":
                self.me()
                return {"users": [public_user(u) for u in s.search_users(q.get("q", ""))]}

            # -- garage ------------------------------------------------------
            if head == "garage":
                me = self.me()
                if method == "PUT":
                    b = self.body()
                    theme = b.get("theme", me["garage_theme"])
                    need(theme in arena.GARAGE_THEMES, 400, "theme is garage or lab")
                    decor = b.get("decor", json.loads(me["garage"] or "{}"))
                    need(isinstance(decor, dict), 400, "decor is an object")
                    s.update_user(me["id"], {"garage_theme": theme, "garage": json.dumps(decor)[:4000]})
                    me = s.user(me["id"])
                have = [a["id"] for a in s.achievements(me["id"])]
                theme = me["garage_theme"]
                return {"theme": theme, "decor": json.loads(me["garage"] or "{}"), "layout": app.garages[theme],
                        "trophies": [dict(arena.ACHIEVEMENTS[a], id=a) for a in have if a in arena.ACHIEVEMENTS],
                        "asset_base": app.asset_base(), "me": public_user(me, full=True), "unread": s.unread(me["id"])}

            # -- store -------------------------------------------------------
            if head == "store":
                viewer = self.me(required=False)
                vid = viewer["id"] if viewer else None
                if len(parts) == 1 and method == "GET":
                    games = s.games("published")
                    if vid:
                        games += [g for g in s.games("testing") if g["author"] == vid]
                    text = q.get("q", "").lower()
                    genre = q.get("genre", "")
                    out = [app.game_view(g, vid) for g in games
                           if (not text or text in g["manifest"]["title"].lower() or text in " ".join(g["manifest"].get("tags", [])))
                           and (not genre or g["manifest"].get("genre") == genre)]
                    return {"games": out, "genres": sorted({g["manifest"].get("genre", "") for g in games} - {""})}
                g = app.visible_game(parts[1], vid)
                need(g is not None, 404, "no such game")
                if len(parts) == 2 and method == "GET":
                    return app.game_view(g, vid, detail=True)
                if len(parts) == 3 and parts[2] == "reviews" and method == "POST":
                    me = self.me()
                    b = self.body()
                    stars = int(b.get("stars") or 0)
                    need(1 <= stars <= 5, 400, "stars is 1 to 5")
                    played = s.one("SELECT 1 AS x FROM matches WHERE user=? AND game=? AND status='done'", (me["id"], g["slug"]))
                    need(played, 403, "play the game before reviewing it")
                    s.review(g["slug"], me["id"], stars, arena.clean_text(b.get("text", ""), 600))
                    return {"rating": s.rating_summary(g["slug"]), "reviews": s.reviews(g["slug"])}

            # -- rooms -------------------------------------------------------
            if head == "rooms":
                viewer = self.me(required=method != "GET")
                vid = viewer["id"] if viewer else None
                if len(parts) == 1:
                    if method == "GET":
                        rooms = s.rooms(vid, mine=q.get("filter") == "mine", game=q.get("game", ""))
                        return {"rooms": [app.room_view(r, vid) for r in rooms]}
                    if method == "POST":
                        b = self.body()
                        name = arena.clean_text(b.get("name", ""), 48)
                        need(len(name) >= 3, 400, "a room needs a name of at least 3 characters")
                        g = app.visible_game(str(b.get("game", "")), vid)
                        need(g is not None, 400, "choose a game from the store")
                        theme = b.get("theme", "arena")
                        need(theme in arena.ROOM_THEMES, 400, "theme is one of " + ", ".join(arena.ROOM_THEMES))
                        vis = b.get("visibility", "public")
                        need(vis in arena.VISIBILITY, 400, "visibility is public, friends or private")
                        need(g["status"] == "published" or vis == "private", 400, "a game still in testing can only be hosted in a private room")
                        mx = max(2, min(64, int(b.get("max_members") or 16)))
                        settings = b.get("settings") if isinstance(b.get("settings"), dict) else {}
                        r = s.create_room(vid, name, g["slug"], theme, vis, arena.clean_text(b.get("description", ""), 200), settings, mx)
                        s.post(r["id"], vid, "%s opened the room" % viewer["handle"], kind="system")
                        app.social_check(vid)
                        return 201, app.room_view(s.room(r["id"]), vid, detail=True)
                r = s.room(parts[1])
                need(r is not None and r["status"] == "open", 404, "no such room")
                need(r["visibility"] == "public" or (vid and s.can_see_room(r, vid)), 404, "no such room")
                rid = r["id"]
                sub = parts[2] if len(parts) > 2 else ""
                if not sub:
                    if method == "GET":
                        return app.room_view(r, vid, detail=True)
                    if method == "PATCH":
                        need(r["host"] == vid, 403, "only the host can change the room")
                        b = self.body()
                        fields = {}
                        if "name" in b:
                            fields["name"] = arena.clean_text(b["name"], 48)
                        if "description" in b:
                            fields["description"] = arena.clean_text(b["description"], 200)
                        if b.get("theme") in arena.ROOM_THEMES:
                            fields["theme"] = b["theme"]
                        if b.get("visibility") in arena.VISIBILITY:
                            fields["visibility"] = b["visibility"]
                        if isinstance(b.get("settings"), dict):
                            fields["settings"] = b["settings"]
                        s.update_room(rid, fields)
                        return app.room_view(s.room(rid), vid, detail=True)
                    if method == "DELETE":
                        need(r["host"] == vid, 403, "only the host can close the room")
                        s.close_room(rid)
                        return {"closed": rid}
                if sub == "join" and method == "POST":
                    need(r["members"] < r["max_members"] or s.is_member(rid, vid), 409, "the room is full")
                    if not s.is_member(rid, vid):
                        s.join_room(rid, vid)
                        s.post(rid, vid, "%s joined" % viewer["handle"], kind="system")
                    return app.room_view(s.room(rid), vid, detail=True)
                if sub == "leave" and method == "POST":
                    need(r["host"] != vid, 409, "the host closes the room instead of leaving it")
                    s.leave_room(rid, vid)
                    s.post(rid, vid, "%s left" % viewer["handle"], kind="system")
                    return {"left": rid}
                if sub == "invite" and method == "POST":
                    need(s.is_member(rid, vid), 403, "join the room first")
                    other = s.user_by_handle(self.body().get("handle", ""))
                    need(other is not None, 404, "no such player")
                    s.notify(other["id"], "invite", "%s invited you to %s" % (viewer["handle"], r["name"]), {"room": rid, "from": viewer["handle"]})
                    return {"invited": other["handle"]}
                if sub == "messages":
                    if method == "GET":
                        return {"messages": s.messages(rid, int(q.get("after") or 0))}
                    if method == "POST":
                        need(s.is_member(rid, vid), 403, "join the room to chat")
                        need(app.chat_limit.ok(vid), 429, "slow down a little")
                        text = arena.clean_text(self.body().get("text", ""))
                        need(text, 400, "say something")
                        mid = s.post(rid, vid, text)
                        return {"id": mid, "messages": s.messages(rid, int(q.get("after") or 0))}
                if sub == "matches" and method == "POST":

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Proves a running Arena works end to end, as a system player (hidden
from the leaderboards): the store lists both official games and serves
their packs; a garage opens with its 3D layout; a private room is opened,
a match is played and its result is rated; the room is closed again.

    arena_smoke.py http://127.0.0.1:8080            # prints arena-smoke-ok
    arena_smoke.py http://127.0.0.1:8080 --forge    # also: the Forge agent builds a game (forge-demo-ok)
"""

import json
import sys
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.request

USER = {"X-Aseman-User": "system:smoke", "X-Aseman-User-Handle": "arena-smoke"}


def call(base, method, path, body=None, raw=False):
    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
    h = dict(USER, **({"Content-Type": "application/json"} if data else {}))
    req = urllib.request.Request(base.rstrip("/") + "/" + path, data=data, method=method, headers=h)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as r:
            out = r.read()
            return out if raw else json.loads(out or b"{}")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        sys.exit("arena-smoke-failed: %s %s → %d %s" % (method, path, e.code, e.read()[:300].decode(errors="replace")))


def main():
    base = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "http://127.0.0.1:8080"
    games = {g["slug"]: g for g in call(base, "GET", "api/store")["games"]}
    for slug in ("arena-chess", "city-strike"):
        if slug not in games:
            sys.exit("arena-smoke-failed: %s is not in the store" % slug)
        g = games[slug]
        pack = call(base, "GET", "games/%s/%s" % (slug, g["launch"]["pack"].split("/")[-1].split("?")[0]), raw=True)
        if pack[:4] != b"GDPC":
            sys.exit("arena-smoke-failed: %s's pack is not a Godot pack" % slug)
    garage = call(base, "GET", "api/garage")
    if len(garage["layout"]["items"]) < 8:
        sys.exit("arena-smoke-failed: the garage has no furniture")
    room = call(base, "POST", "api/rooms", {"name": "Smoke test", "game": "arena-chess", "theme": "arena", "visibility": "private", "settings": {"level": 2}})
    out = call(base, "POST", "api/rooms/%s/matches" % room["id"], {})
    if out["launch"]["params"].get("level") != 2 or not out["launch"]["pack"]:
        sys.exit("arena-smoke-failed: the match did not launch with the room's settings")
    res = call(base, "POST", "api/matches/%s/result" % out["match"]["id"],
               {"token": out["match"]["token"], "type": "result", "game": "arena-chess", "outcome": "loss", "reason": "resignation", "score": 20, "duration_s": 0, "level": 2})
    if "rating" not in res:
        sys.exit("arena-smoke-failed: the result was not rated")
    call(base, "DELETE", "api/rooms/" + room["id"])
    print("arena-smoke-ok: %d games, garage of %d models, a rated match (%+d)" % (len(games), len(garage["layout"]["items"]), res["rating_change"]))
    if "--forge" in sys.argv:
        p = call(base, "POST", "api/forge", {"title": "Orbit Dodge", "genre": "arcade",
                 "brief": "A small 3D arcade game: steer a ship around a planet and dodge three AI hunter drones that predict your path; survive 90 seconds to win. Keep it simple and finish it."})
        pid = p["project"]["id"]
        deadline = time.time() + 55 * 60
        while time.time() < deadline:
            time.sleep(20)
            st = call(base, "GET", "api/forge/" + pid)
            if st["project"]["status"] in ("ready", "published"):
                print("forge-demo-ok: %s built %s" % (pid, st["project"]["slug"]))
                return 0
            last = st["messages"][-1]
            if last["state"] == "failed":
                sys.exit("forge-demo-failed: " + last["text"][:300])
            if last["state"] == "done" and last["role"] == "agent" and st["project"]["status"] == "drafting":
                call(base, "POST", "api/forge/%s/messages" % pid, {"text": "Sounds good — please build it now, test it and submit it."})
        sys.exit("forge-demo-failed: the game was not submitted in time")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/bin/sh
# Builds Aseman Arena's games: fetches their models, imports the project,
# runs its tests, and exports
#   build/<slug>/<slug>.pck    the resource pack the Aseman client's Scene3D mounts
#   build/<slug>/web/          the browser build (Web, no threads)
#   build/<slug>/game.json     the store manifest, with sizes and checksums
#
#   games/build.sh [chess|city-strike|all] [--out DIR] [--no-web] [--no-tests] [--offline]
#
# GODOT names the Godot 4.3 editor; without it godot_setup.py installs one.
# --offline builds without downloading models (the games' own stand-ins).
set -eu
HERE=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
WHICH=all
OUT="$HERE/build"
WEB=1
TESTS=1
OFFLINE=0
while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    --out) OUT=$2; shift ;;
    --no-web) WEB=0 ;;
    --no-tests) TESTS=0 ;;
    --offline) OFFLINE=1 ;;
    chess|city-strike|all) WHICH=$1 ;;
    *) echo "unknown argument: $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
  esac
  shift
done
if [ -z "${GODOT:-}" ]; then
  if [ "$WEB" = 1 ]; then GODOT=$(python3 "$HERE/godot_setup.py"); else GODOT=$(python3 "$HERE/godot_setup.py" --no-web); fi
elif [ "$WEB" = 1 ]; then
  python3 "$HERE/godot_setup.py" >/dev/null
fi
mkdir -p "$OUT"
OUT=$(cd "$OUT" && pwd)

quiet() { grep -v "mesh_get_surface_count\|Parameter \"m\" is null\|leaked at exit\|still in use at exit\|in use exist at exit\|^   at: \|^     at: \|ObjectDB instances\|^Godot Engine\|^$\|UVs are required" || true; }

build_one() {
  dir=$1
  slug=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))['slug'])" "$HERE/$dir/game.json")
  echo "== $slug"
  if [ "$OFFLINE" = 0 ]; then python3 "$HERE/fetch_assets.py" "$dir" | tail -1; fi
  "$GODOT" --headless --path "$HERE/$dir" --import 2>&1 | quiet | grep -i "error" || true
  if [ "$TESTS" = 1 ]; then
    for t in "$HERE/$dir"/tests/run_tests.gd "$HERE/$dir"/tests/test_scene.gd; do
      [ -f "$t" ] || continue
      name=$(basename "$t")
      timeout 900 "$GODOT" --headless --path "$HERE/$dir" --script "res://tests/$name" 2>&1 | quiet | tee "$OUT/$slug-$name.log" | tail -3
      grep -q " passed" "$OUT/$slug-$name.log" || { echo "tests failed: $dir/tests/$name" >&2; exit 1; }
    done
  fi
  mkdir -p "$OUT/$slug"
  cp "$HERE/$dir"/arena/*/icon.svg "$OUT/$slug/icon.svg"
  "$GODOT" --headless --path "$HERE/$dir" --export-pack "Web" "$OUT/$slug/$slug.pck" 2>&1 | quiet | grep -i "error" || true
  test -s "$OUT/$slug/$slug.pck" || { echo "no pack for $slug" >&2; exit 1; }
  if [ "$WEB" = 1 ]; then
    rm -rf "$OUT/$slug/web" && mkdir -p "$OUT/$slug/web"
    "$GODOT" --headless --path "$HERE/$dir" --export-release "Web" "$OUT/$slug/web/index.html" 2>&1 | quiet | grep -i "error" || true
    test -s "$OUT/$slug/web/index.wasm" || { echo "no web build for $slug" >&2; exit 1; }
  fi
  python3 - "$HERE/$dir/game.json" "$OUT/$slug" "$WEB" <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, os, sys, time
src, out, web = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3] == "1"
g = json.load(open(src))
pck = os.path.join(out, g["pack"])
g["pack_bytes"] = os.path.getsize(pck)
g["pack_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(open(pck, "rb").read()).hexdigest()
if not web:
    g.pop("web", None)
g["built_at"] = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime())
json.dump(g, open(os.path.join(out, "game.json"), "w"), indent=2)
print("built %s %s (%d KB pack)" % (g["slug"], g["version"], g["pack_bytes"] // 1024))
PY
  [ -f "$HERE/$dir/arena/"*/models/LICENSES.md ] 2>/dev/null && cp "$HERE/$dir"/arena/*/models/LICENSES.md "$OUT/$slug/" || true
}

case "$WHICH" in
  all) build_one chess; build_one city-strike ;;
  *) build_one "$WHICH" ;;
esac
echo "games-built $OUT"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Downloads the 3D models Aseman Arena uses (assets.json), at build time.

    python3 fetch_assets.py chess            # into games/chess/...
    python3 fetch_assets.py city-strike
    python3 fetch_assets.py garage --out ../app/public/assets/models
    python3 fetch_assets.py all
    python3 fetch_assets.py --list           # sources and licences

Layout it writes under a target's dest:
  * a Poly Haven model as glTF: <as>/<as>.gltf with its .bin and textures/
    (Godot imports it; the textures stay separate files);
  * a Poly Haven model as glb: <as> — one self-contained binary glTF, packed
    here from the glTF, its buffer and its textures (what a Scene3D loads at
    run time from one address);
  * a file from a pinned repository: <source>/<as>, with the files every
    model of that source references (Kenney's Textures/colormap.png).

Every source is CC0; LICENSES.md is written beside the models with each
model's source, author and licence. Already-downloaded files are kept, so a
rerun only fetches what is missing. Standard library only.
"""

import argparse
import json
import os
import struct
import sys
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.request

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
UA = {"User-Agent": "aseman-arena-asset-fetcher/1.0"}


def get(url, tries=4):
    last = None
    for n in range(tries):
        try:
            req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=UA)
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=120) as r:
                return r.read()
        except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, OSError) as e:
            last = e
            time.sleep(2 ** n)
    raise RuntimeError("could not download %s: %s" % (url, last))


def save(path, data):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path) or ".", exist_ok=True)
    tmp = path + ".part"
    with open(tmp, "wb") as f:
        f.write(data)
    os.replace(tmp, path)


def polyhaven_files(asset_id, res):
    info = json.loads(get("https://api.polyhaven.com/files/%s" % asset_id))
    gltf = info["gltf"].get(res) or info["gltf"][sorted(info["gltf"])[0]]
    return gltf["gltf"]


def fetch_polyhaven_gltf(asset_id, folder, name, res="1k"):
    """The glTF and everything it includes, under folder/."""
    entry = polyhaven_files(asset_id, res)
    main = os.path.join(folder, name + ".gltf")
    if not os.path.exists(main):
        for rel, inc in entry.get("include", {}).items():
            dst = os.path.join(folder, rel)
            if not os.path.exists(dst):
                save(dst, get(inc["url"]))
        save(main, get(entry["url"]))
    return main


def pack_glb(gltf_path):
    """A self-contained .glb from a .gltf and its external files: the one
    buffer becomes the GLB's BIN chunk, every image a buffer view in it."""
    folder = os.path.dirname(gltf_path)
    doc = json.load(open(gltf_path, encoding="utf-8"))
    blob = bytearray()

    def append(data):
        while len(blob) % 4:
            blob.append(0)
        off = len(blob)
        blob.extend(data)
        return off

    # Buffers: concatenate, remember each one's offset in the new blob.
    offsets = []
    for buf in doc.get("buffers", []):
        uri = buf.get("uri")
        data = open(os.path.join(folder, urllib.request.url2pathname(uri)), "rb").read() if uri else b""
        offsets.append(append(data))
    for view in doc.get("bufferViews", []):
        view["byteOffset"] = view.get("byteOffset", 0) + offsets[view.get("buffer", 0)]
        view["buffer"] = 0
    for img in doc.get("images", []):
        uri = img.pop("uri", None)
        if not uri:
            continue
        data = open(os.path.join(folder, urllib.request.url2pathname(uri)), "rb").read()
        off = append(data)
        doc.setdefault("bufferViews", []).append({"buffer": 0, "byteOffset": off, "byteLength": len(data)})
        img["bufferView"] = len(doc["bufferViews"]) - 1
        img["mimeType"] = "image/png" if uri.lower().endswith(".png") else "image/jpeg"
    while len(blob) % 4:
        blob.append(0)
    doc["buffers"] = [{"byteLength": len(blob)}]
    js = json.dumps(doc, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
    js += b" " * ((4 - len(js) % 4) % 4)
    out = struct.pack("<III", 0x46546C67, 2, 12 + 8 + len(js) + 8 + len(blob))
    out += struct.pack("<II", len(js), 0x4E4F534A) + js
    out += struct.pack("<II", len(blob), 0x004E4942) + bytes(blob)
    return out


def check_glb(data):
    if len(data) < 20 or struct.unpack("<I", data[:4])[0] != 0x46546C67:
        raise RuntimeError("not a binary glTF")
    n = struct.unpack("<I", data[12:16])[0]
    json.loads(data[20:20 + n])


def fetch_target(manifest, key, out=None, cache=None):
    target = manifest["targets"][key]
    dest = out or os.path.join(HERE, target["dest"])
    cache = cache or os.path.join(HERE, ".cache")
    os.makedirs(dest, exist_ok=True)
    rows = []
    for item in target["items"]:
        src = manifest["sources"][item["source"]]
        name = item["as"]
        if item["source"] == "polyhaven":
            fmt = item.get("format", "gltf")
            if fmt == "gltf":
                path = fetch_polyhaven_gltf(item["id"], os.path.join(dest, name), name, item.get("res", "1k"))
            else:
                path = os.path.join(dest, name)
                if not os.path.exists(path):
                    stem = os.path.splitext(name)[0]
                    gltf = fetch_polyhaven_gltf(item["id"], os.path.join(cache, "polyhaven", stem), stem, item.get("res", "1k"))
                    data = pack_glb(gltf)
                    check_glb(data)
                    save(path, data)
            rows.append((name, "Poly Haven — " + item["id"], "https://polyhaven.com/a/" + item["id"], src["license"]))
        else:
            folder = os.path.join(dest, item["source"])
            if key == "garage":
                folder = dest
            path = os.path.join(folder, name)
            if not os.path.exists(path):
                data = get(src["base"] + item["file"])
                if name.endswith(".glb"):
                    check_glb(data)
                save(path, data)
            for extra in src.get("extra", []):
                ep = os.path.join(folder, extra)
                if not os.path.exists(ep):
                    save(ep, get(src["base"] + extra))
            rows.append((name, src["name"], src["url"], src["license"]))
        print("  ok", key, name)
    with open(os.path.join(dest, "LICENSES.md"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write("# Third-party models (%s)\n\nDownloaded by `games/fetch_assets.py` from `games/assets.json`.\n\n" % key)
        f.write("| File | Model | Source | Licence |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n")
        for r in rows:
            f.write("| `%s` | %s | %s | %s |\n" % r)
    return dest


def main(argv=None):
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n")[0])
    ap.add_argument("target", nargs="?", default="all")
    ap.add_argument("--out", help="write the target here instead of its dest")
    ap.add_argument("--list", action="store_true")
    a = ap.parse_args(argv)
    manifest = json.load(open(os.path.join(HERE, "assets.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    if a.list:
        for k, s in manifest["sources"].items():
            print("%-14s %-55s %s" % (k, s["name"], s["license"]))
        return 0
    keys = list(manifest["targets"]) if a.target == "all" else [a.target]
    for k in keys:
        if k not in manifest["targets"]:
            print("unknown target %s (have: %s)" % (k, ", ".join(manifest["targets"])), file=sys.stderr)
            return 2
        dest = fetch_target(manifest, k, a.out if len(keys) == 1 else None)
        print("assets-ok %s -> %s" % (k, dest))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Installs the Godot 4.3 editor (Linux) and the one export template the
games need, without the whole 1 GB template archive.

    python3 godot_setup.py [--dir DIR]       # prints the editor's path

The editor comes from Godot's GitHub release. The Web template
(web_nothreads_release.zip and its debug twin: no SharedArrayBuffer, so the games run in any
page, iframes included) is read straight out of the release's .tpz with HTTP
range requests: only the archive's directory and that one entry are
downloaded. 4.3 matches the engine embedded in the Aseman client
(org.godotengine:godot:4.3.0.stable), so the games' resource packs load there.
Standard library only.
"""

import argparse
import io
import os
import stat
import struct
import sys
import urllib.request
import zipfile
import zlib

VERSION = "4.3"
TAG = VERSION + "-stable"
BASE = "https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases/download/%s/" % TAG
EDITOR = "Godot_v%s_linux.x86_64" % TAG
TPZ = "Godot_v%s_export_templates.tpz" % TAG
# The editor checks that both exist before any Web export.
WEB_TEMPLATES = ["templates/web_nothreads_release.zip", "templates/web_nothreads_debug.zip"]
UA = {"User-Agent": "aseman-arena-godot-setup/1.0"}


def fetch(url, start=None, end=None):
    headers = dict(UA)
    if start is not None:
        headers["Range"] = "bytes=%d-%d" % (start, end)
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=headers)
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=600) as r:
        return r.read(), r.headers


def content_length(url):
    data, headers = fetch(url, 0, 0)
    rng = headers.get("Content-Range", "")
    if "/" not in rng:
        raise RuntimeError("the server does not serve byte ranges for " + url)
    return int(rng.rsplit("/", 1)[1])


def remote_zip_member(url, name):
    """One member of a zip at [url], read with range requests."""
    size = content_length(url)
    tail_len = min(size, 66000)
    tail, _ = fetch(url, size - tail_len, size - 1)
    eocd = tail.rfind(b"PK\x05\x06")
    if eocd < 0:
        raise RuntimeError("no zip directory at the end of " + url)
    cd_size, cd_off = struct.unpack("<II", tail[eocd + 12:eocd + 20])
    if cd_off == 0xFFFFFFFF:  # zip64
        loc = tail.rfind(b"PK\x06\x07")
        z64_off = struct.unpack("<Q", tail[loc + 8:loc + 16])[0]
        z64, _ = fetch(url, z64_off, z64_off + 55)
        cd_size, cd_off = struct.unpack("<QQ", z64[40:56])
    cd, _ = fetch(url, cd_off, cd_off + cd_size - 1)
    i = 0
    while i < len(cd):
        if cd[i:i + 4] != b"PK\x01\x02":
            break
        method, = struct.unpack("<H", cd[i + 10:i + 12])
        csize, usize = struct.unpack("<II", cd[i + 20:i + 28])
        nlen, xlen, clen = struct.unpack("<HHH", cd[i + 28:i + 34])
        hoff, = struct.unpack("<I", cd[i + 42:i + 46])
        fname = cd[i + 46:i + 46 + nlen].decode()
        extra = cd[i + 46 + nlen:i + 46 + nlen + xlen]
        if 0xFFFFFFFF in (csize, usize, hoff):
            # zip64 extended information: the 0xFFFFFFFF fields, in order.
            j = 0
            while j < len(extra):
                hid, hsz = struct.unpack("<HH", extra[j:j + 4])
                if hid == 1:
                    vals = list(struct.unpack("<%dQ" % (hsz // 8), extra[j + 4:j + 4 + hsz]))
                    if usize == 0xFFFFFFFF:
                        usize = vals.pop(0)
                    if csize == 0xFFFFFFFF:
                        csize = vals.pop(0)
                    if hoff == 0xFFFFFFFF:
                        hoff = vals.pop(0)
                j += 4 + hsz
        if fname == name:
            head, _ = fetch(url, hoff, hoff + 29)
            lnlen, lxlen = struct.unpack("<HH", head[26:30])
            start = hoff + 30 + lnlen + lxlen
            data, _ = fetch(url, start, start + csize - 1)
            if method == 8:
                data = zlib.decompress(data, -15)
            elif method != 0:
                raise RuntimeError("unsupported compression %d" % method)
            if len(data) != usize:
                raise RuntimeError("size mismatch reading %s" % name)
            return data
        i += 46 + nlen + xlen + clen
    raise RuntimeError("%s is not in %s" % (name, url))


def main(argv=None):
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--dir", default=os.path.join(os.path.expanduser("~"), ".cache", "aseman-godot"))
    ap.add_argument("--no-web", action="store_true", help="skip the Web export template")
    a = ap.parse_args(argv)
    os.makedirs(a.dir, exist_ok=True)
    editor = os.path.join(a.dir, EDITOR)
    if not os.path.exists(editor):
        print("downloading the Godot %s editor…" % VERSION, file=sys.stderr)
        data, _ = fetch(BASE + EDITOR + ".zip")
        with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data)) as z:
            with open(editor, "wb") as f:
                f.write(z.read(EDITOR))
        os.chmod(editor, os.stat(editor).st_mode | stat.S_IXUSR | stat.S_IXGRP | stat.S_IXOTH)
    if not a.no_web:
        tdir = os.path.join(os.path.expanduser("~"), ".local", "share", "godot", "export_templates", VERSION + ".stable")
        for member in WEB_TEMPLATES:
            target = os.path.join(tdir, os.path.basename(member))
            if os.path.exists(target):
                continue
            print("fetching %s from the release archive…" % os.path.basename(member), file=sys.stderr)
            data = remote_zip_member(BASE + TPZ, member)
            os.makedirs(tdir, exist_ok=True)
            with open(target + ".part", "wb") as f:
                f.write(data)
            os.replace(target + ".part", target)
        with open(os.path.join(tdir, "version.txt"), "w") as f:
            f.write(VERSION + ".stable")
    print(editor)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

				var idx := (7 - r) * 8 + f if not black else r * 8 + f
				mg[s] = MG_VALUE[t] + MG_PST[t][idx]
				eg[s] = EG_VALUE[t] + EG_PST[t][idx]
		_mg[p] = mg
		_eg[p] = eg


func _init(lvl: int = 3, seed: int = 0) -> void:
	_init_tables()
	level = clampi(lvl, 1, 5)
	if seed:
		_rng.seed = seed
	else:
		_rng.randomize()


## Static evaluation, from the point of view of the side to move.
func evaluate(pos) -> int:
	var mg := [0, 0]
	var eg := [0, 0]
	var phase := 0
	var bishops := [0, 0]
	var b: PackedInt32Array = pos.board
	for s in 64:
		var p := b[s]
		if p == 0:
			continue
		var c := 1 if p & 8 else 0
		mg[c] += _mg[p][s]
		eg[c] += _eg[p][s]
		var t := p & 7
		phase += PHASE_INC[t]
		if t == Rules.BISHOP:
			bishops[c] += 1
	for c in 2:
		if bishops[c] >= 2:
			mg[c] += 30
			eg[c] += 50
	var us: int = pos.side
	var mg_score: int = mg[us] - mg[1 - us]
	var eg_score: int = eg[us] - eg[1 - us]
	var ph: int = min(phase, 24)
	return (mg_score * ph + eg_score * (24 - ph)) / 24 + 10   # +10: the move


func _victim_value(pos, m: int) -> int:
	var flags := Rules.move_flags(m)
	if flags & Rules.F_EP:
		return 100
	return MG_VALUE[pos.board[Rules.move_to(m)] & 7]


func _order(pos, moves: PackedInt32Array, best: int, ply: int) -> Array:
	var scored := []
	for m in moves:
		var score := 0
		if m == best:
			score = 10000000
		elif Rules.move_flags(m) & Rules.F_CAPTURE:
			score = 1000000 + _victim_value(pos, m) * 10 - MG_VALUE[pos.board[Rules.move_from(m)] & 7] / 10
		elif Rules.move_promo(m):
			score = 900000 + Rules.move_promo(m)
		elif ply < _killers.size() and (_killers[ply][0] == m or _killers[ply][1] == m):
			score = 800000
		else:
			score = _history_h.get(m & 0xFFF, 0)
		scored.append([score, m])
	scored.sort_custom(func(a, b): return a[0] > b[0])
	return scored


func _time_up() -> bool:
	if _stopped:
		return true
	if (nodes & 1023) == 0 and Time.get_ticks_msec() >= _deadline:
		_stopped = true
	return _stopped


func _quiesce(pos, alpha: int, beta: int, ply: int) -> int:
	nodes += 1
	if _time_up():
		return 0
	var stand := evaluate(pos)
	if stand >= beta:
		return beta
	if stand > alpha:
		alpha = stand
	if ply > 40:
		return stand
	var us: int = pos.side
	for entry in _order(pos, pos.pseudo_moves(true), -1, ply):
		var m: int = entry[1]
		# Delta pruning: even winning this piece cannot lift alpha.
		if Rules.move_promo(m) == 0 and stand + _victim_value(pos, m) + 200 < alpha:
			continue
		pos.make(m)
		if pos.is_attacked(pos.king_sq[us], 1 - us):
			pos.unmake()
			continue
		var score := -_quiesce(pos, -beta, -alpha, ply + 1)
		pos.unmake()
		if _stopped:
			return 0
		if score >= beta:
			return beta
		if score > alpha:
			alpha = score
	return alpha


func _search(pos, depth: int, alpha: int, beta: int, ply: int, allow_null: bool) -> int:
	if depth <= 0:
		return _quiesce(pos, alpha, beta, ply)
	nodes += 1
	if _time_up():
		return 0
	if ply > 0:
		if pos.halfmove >= 100 or pos.repetitions() >= 2 or pos.insufficient_material():
			return 0
	var key: int = pos.hash
	var tt_move := -1
	var tt = _tt.get(key)
	if tt != null:
		tt_move = tt[3]
		if tt[0] >= depth and ply > 0:
			var v: int = tt[1]
			match tt[2]:
				0:
					return v
				1:
					if v >= beta:
						return v
				2:
					if v <= alpha:
						return v
	var us: int = pos.side
	var checked: bool = pos.is_attacked(pos.king_sq[us], 1 - us)
	if checked:
		depth += 1   # check extension
	# Null move: if passing still beats beta, this line is too good to be true.
	if allow_null and not checked and depth >= 3 and ply > 0 and _has_pieces(pos, us):
		pos.make_null()
		var score := -_search(pos, depth - 3, -beta, -beta + 1, ply + 1, false)
		pos.unmake_null()
		if _stopped:
			return 0
		if score >= beta:
			return beta
	var orig_alpha := alpha
	var best := -INF
	var best_move := -1
	var legal := 0
	while _killers.size() <= ply:
		_killers.append([-1, -1])
	for entry in _order(pos, pos.pseudo_moves(), tt_move, ply):
		var m: int = entry[1]
		pos.make(m)
		if pos.is_attacked(pos.king_sq[us], 1 - us):
			pos.unmake()
			continue
		legal += 1
		var score: int
		if legal == 1:
			score = -_search(pos, depth - 1, -beta, -alpha, ply + 1, true)
		else:
			# Late quiet moves get a reduced, null-window look first.
			var r := 1 if legal > 4 and depth >= 3 and not checked and not (Rules.move_flags(m) & Rules.F_CAPTURE) and Rules.move_promo(m) == 0 else 0
			score = -_search(pos, depth - 1 - r, -alpha - 1, -alpha, ply + 1, true)
			if score > alpha and not _stopped:
				score = -_search(pos, depth - 1, -beta, -alpha, ply + 1, true)
		pos.unmake()
		if _stopped:
			return 0
		if score > best:
			best = score
			best_move = m
		if score > alpha:
			alpha = score
		if alpha >= beta:
			if not (Rules.move_flags(m) & Rules.F_CAPTURE):
				if _killers[ply][0] != m:
					_killers[ply][1] = _killers[ply][0]
					_killers[ply][0] = m
				_history_h[m & 0xFFF] = _history_h.get(m & 0xFFF, 0) + depth * depth
			break
	if legal == 0:
		return -MATE + ply if checked else 0
	var flag := 0
	if best <= orig_alpha:
		flag = 2
	elif best >= beta:
		flag = 1
	if _tt.size() > 200000:
		_tt.clear()
	_tt[key] = [depth, best, flag, best_move]
	return best


func _has_pieces(pos, who: int) -> bool:
	var col := 8 if who == 1 else 0
	for s in 64:
		var p: int = pos.board[s]
		if p and (p & 8) == col and (p & 7) != Rules.PAWN and (p & 7) != Rules.KING:
			return true
	return false


## Chooses a move for the side to move in [pos] (which it leaves unchanged).
## Returns {"move": int, "score": int, "depth": int, "nodes": int, "pv": String}.
func choose(pos, max_ms: int = -1) -> Dictionary:
	var cfg: Array = LEVELS[level]
	var max_depth: int = cfg[0]
	var think: int = cfg[1] if max_ms < 0 else max_ms
	var blur: int = cfg[2]
	nodes = 0
	_stopped = false
	_deadline = Time.get_ticks_msec() + think
	_killers.clear()
	_history_h.clear()
	var work = pos.clone()
	var root_moves: PackedInt32Array = work.legal_moves()
	if root_moves.is_empty():
		return {"move": -1, "score": 0, "depth": 0, "nodes": 0}
	if root_moves.size() == 1:
		return {"move": root_moves[0], "score": 0, "depth": 0, "nodes": 0}
	var best_move := root_moves[0]
	var best_score := -INF
	var scores := {}
	var reached := 0
	for depth in range(1, max_depth + 1):
		var alpha := -INF
		var beta := INF
		var iter_best := -1
		var iter_score := -INF
		var iter_scores := {}
		var ordered := _order(work, root_moves, best_move, 0)
		for entry in ordered:
			var m: int = entry[1]
			work.make(m)
			var score: int
			if iter_best < 0 or blur > 0:
				# Blurred levels need every root move's true score to choose
				# among the near-best, so they search each with a full window.
				score = -_search(work, depth - 1, -beta, -(alpha if blur == 0 else -INF), 1, true)
			else:
				score = -_search(work, depth - 1, -alpha - 1, -alpha, 1, true)
				if score > alpha and not _stopped:
					score = -_search(work, depth - 1, -beta, -alpha, 1, true)
			work.unmake()
			if _stopped:
				break
			iter_scores[m] = score
			if score > iter_score:
				iter_score = score
				iter_best = m
			if score > alpha:
				alpha = score
		if _stopped and iter_best < 0:
			break
		if iter_best >= 0 and (not _stopped or iter_score > best_score):
			best_move = iter_best
			best_score = iter_score
			scores = iter_scores
			reached = depth
		if _stopped or best_score > MATE - 100:
			break
	# Blur: pick randomly among moves within [blur] of the best (weaker levels).
	if blur > 0 and scores.size() > 1:
		var near := []
		for m in scores:
			if scores[m] >= best_score - blur and abs(scores[m]) < MATE - 100:
				near.append(m)
		if near.size() > 1 and best_score < MATE - 100:
			best_move = near[_rng.randi_range(0, near.size() - 1)]
	return {"move": best_move, "score": best_score, "depth": reached, "nodes": nodes,
		"uci": Rules.uci(best_move)}

	Rules.QUEEN: [[0.0, 0.0], [0.38, 0.0], [0.38, 0.07], [0.3, 0.12], [0.22, 0.16], [0.13, 0.78], [0.25, 0.82], [0.25, 0.86], [0.15, 0.9], [0.2, 1.06], [0.25, 1.14], [0.15, 1.16], [0.08, 1.22], [0.08, 1.26], [0.0, 1.3]],
	Rules.KING: [[0.0, 0.0], [0.38, 0.0], [0.38, 0.07], [0.3, 0.12], [0.22, 0.16], [0.14, 0.84], [0.26, 0.88], [0.26, 0.92], [0.16, 0.96], [0.21, 1.14], [0.23, 1.2], [0.0, 1.22]],
	Rules.KNIGHT: [[0.0, 0.0], [0.34, 0.0], [0.34, 0.06], [0.27, 0.1], [0.2, 0.14], [0.17, 0.3], [0.22, 0.34], [0.0, 0.36]],
}


static func _material(white: bool) -> StandardMaterial3D:
	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	if white:
		m.albedo_color = Color(0.93, 0.9, 0.84)
		m.roughness = 0.28
		m.clearcoat_enabled = true
		m.clearcoat = 0.6
	else:
		m.albedo_color = Color(0.08, 0.075, 0.07)
		m.roughness = 0.22
		m.metallic = 0.1
		m.clearcoat_enabled = true
		m.clearcoat = 0.8
	return m


static func lathe(profile: Array, scale: float, segments: int = 40) -> ArrayMesh:
	var st := SurfaceTool.new()
	st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
	for i in profile.size() - 1:
		var a: Array = profile[i]
		var b: Array = profile[i + 1]
		for j in segments:
			var t0 := TAU * j / segments
			var t1 := TAU * (j + 1) / segments
			var p00 := Vector3(cos(t0) * a[0], a[1], sin(t0) * a[0]) * scale
			var p01 := Vector3(cos(t1) * a[0], a[1], sin(t1) * a[0]) * scale
			var p10 := Vector3(cos(t0) * b[0], b[1], sin(t0) * b[0]) * scale
			var p11 := Vector3(cos(t1) * b[0], b[1], sin(t1) * b[0]) * scale
			st.add_vertex(p00)
			st.add_vertex(p10)
			st.add_vertex(p11)
			st.add_vertex(p00)
			st.add_vertex(p11)
			st.add_vertex(p01)
	st.generate_normals()
	return st.commit()


static func _part(mesh: Mesh, mat: Material, pos: Vector3 = Vector3.ZERO, rot: Vector3 = Vector3.ZERO) -> MeshInstance3D:
	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
	mi.mesh = mesh
	mi.material_override = mat
	mi.position = pos
	mi.rotation_degrees = rot
	return mi


## One template per piece code.
static func build_templates(square: float) -> Dictionary:
	var out := {}
	for white in [true, false]:
		var mat := _material(white)
		for t in PROFILES:
			var holder := Node3D.new()
			holder.add_child(_part(lathe(PROFILES[t], square), mat))
			match t:
				Rules.KNIGHT:
					# The horse's head: a sculpted neck and muzzle on the base.
					var neck := BoxMesh.new()
					neck.size = Vector3(0.22, 0.5, 0.34) * square
					holder.add_child(_part(neck, mat, Vector3(0, 0.56, -0.02) * square, Vector3(-14, 0, 0)))
					var head := BoxMesh.new()
					head.size = Vector3(0.2, 0.2, 0.44) * square
					holder.add_child(_part(head, mat, Vector3(0, 0.78, 0.1) * square, Vector3(24, 0, 0)))
					var mane := BoxMesh.new()
					mane.size = Vector3(0.08, 0.46, 0.08) * square
					holder.add_child(_part(mane, mat, Vector3(0, 0.62, -0.18) * square, Vector3(-12, 0, 0)))
					for side in [-1, 1]:
						var ear := PrismMesh.new()
						ear.size = Vector3(0.06, 0.12, 0.06) * square
						holder.add_child(_part(ear, mat, Vector3(side * 0.06, 0.92, -0.04) * square))
					if not white:
						holder.rotation_degrees.y = 180
				Rules.KING:
					var bar := BoxMesh.new()
					bar.size = Vector3(0.07, 0.26, 0.07) * square
					holder.add_child(_part(bar, mat, Vector3(0, 1.33, 0) * square))
					var cross := BoxMesh.new()
					cross.size = Vector3(0.2, 0.07, 0.07) * square
					holder.add_child(_part(cross, mat, Vector3(0, 1.36, 0) * square))
				Rules.QUEEN:
					for k in 8:
						var bead := SphereMesh.new()
						bead.radius = 0.035 * square
						bead.height = 0.07 * square
						var a := TAU * k / 8.0
						holder.add_child(_part(bead, mat, Vector3(cos(a) * 0.22, 1.17, sin(a) * 0.22) * square))
				Rules.ROOK:
					# Crenellations: four merlons.
					for k in 4:
						var merlon := BoxMesh.new()
						merlon.size = Vector3(0.14, 0.1, 0.1) * square
						var a := TAU * k / 4.0 + PI / 4
						holder.add_child(_part(merlon, mat, Vector3(cos(a) * 0.22, 0.88, sin(a) * 0.22) * square, Vector3(0, -rad_to_deg(a), 0)))
			out[t | (0 if white else Rules.BLACK)] = holder
	return out


## A marble board with a walnut frame and coordinates.
static func build_board(root: Node3D, square: float, origin: float, top: float) -> void:
	var light := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	light.albedo_color = Color(0.86, 0.83, 0.76)

			tile.position = Vector3(-(origin + f * square), top - 0.01, origin + r * square)

	for i in 8:

			root.add_child(file_label)

## Headless tests of the chess rules and the AI:
##   godot --headless --path games/chess --script res://tests/run_tests.gd
## Prints "chess-tests passed N" or the failures, and exits non-zero on one.
extends SceneTree

const Rules = preload("res://arena/chess/chess_rules.gd")
const AI = preload("res://arena/chess/chess_ai.gd")

var failures := []
var checks := 0


func check(cond: bool, what: String) -> void:
	checks += 1
	if not cond:
		failures.append(what)
		printerr("FAIL: ", what)


func perft(pos, depth: int) -> int:
	if depth == 0:
		return 1
	var moves: PackedInt32Array = pos.legal_moves()
	if depth == 1:
		return moves.size()
	var n := 0
	for m in moves:
		pos.make(m)
		n += perft(pos, depth - 1)
		pos.unmake()
	return n


func play(pos, sans: Array) -> bool:
	for s in sans:
		var m: int = pos.move_from_san(s)
		if m < 0:
			printerr("illegal in test line: ", s, " at ", pos.fen())
			return false
		pos.make(m)
	return true


func _init() -> void:
	var t0 := Time.get_ticks_msec()
	# --- Perft: move generation against published node counts -------------
	var cases := [
		[Rules.START_FEN, [20, 400, 8902]],
		# "Kiwipete": castling, en passant, promotions, pins, checks.
		["r3k2r/p1ppqpb1/bn2pnp1/3PN3/1p2P3/2N2Q1p/PPPBBPPP/R3K2R w KQkq - 0 1", [48, 2039]],
		# Position 3: en passant discovered checks, rook endings.
		["8/2p5/3p4/KP5r/1R3p1k/8/4P1P1/8 w - - 0 1", [14, 191, 2812]],
		# Position 4: promotions and castling under check.
		["r3k2r/Pppp1ppp/1b3nbN/nP6/BBP1P3/q4N2/Pp1P2PP/R2Q1RK1 w kq - 0 1", [6, 264, 9467]],
		# Position 5.
		["rnbq1k1r/pp1Pbppp/2p5/8/2B5/8/PPP1NnPP/RNBQK2R w KQ - 1 8", [44, 1486]],
	]
	for c in cases:
		var pos = Rules.new(c[0])
		for d in c[1].size():
			var n := perft(pos, d + 1)
			check(n == c[1][d], "perft(%d) of %s: %d, expected %d" % [d + 1, c[0], n, c[1][d]])
		check(pos.fen() == c[0], "make/unmake restores " + c[0])
		check(pos.hash == pos.compute_hash(), "incremental hash matches after perft")

	# --- FEN round trip --------------------------------------------------
	var p = Rules.new()
	check(p.fen() == Rules.START_FEN, "start FEN round trip")

	# --- SAN, check, checkmate (fool's mate) ------------------------------
	p = Rules.new()
	check(play(p, ["f3", "e5", "g4", "Qh4#"]), "fool's mate line is legal")
	var st: Dictionary = p.status()
	check(st.over and st.result == "0-1" and st.reason == "checkmate", "fool's mate is checkmate, 0-1")

	# Scholar's mate, white wins; SAN of the mating move carries '#'.
	p = Rules.new()
	play(p, ["e4", "e5", "Qh5", "Nc6", "Bc4", "Nf6"])
	var mate: int = p.move_from_san("Qxf7#")
	check(mate >= 0 and p.san(mate) == "Qxf7#", "SAN of Qxf7# is Qxf7#")
	p.make(mate)
	st = p.status()
	check(st.over and st.result == "1-0", "scholar's mate is 1-0")

	# --- Stalemate --------------------------------------------------------
	p = Rules.new("7k/5Q2/6K1/8/8/8/8/8 b - - 0 1")
	st = p.status()
	check(st.over and st.reason == "stalemate" and st.result == "1/2-1/2", "stalemate is a draw")

	# --- Castling: rights, through check, into check, rook placement ------
	p = Rules.new("r3k2r/8/8/8/8/8/8/R3K2R w KQkq - 0 1")
	var oo: int = p.move_from_san("O-O")
	var ooo: int = p.move_from_san("O-O-O")
	check(oo >= 0 and ooo >= 0, "both castles legal")
	p.make(oo)
	check(p.piece_at(Rules.sq_from_name("g1")) == Rules.KING and p.piece_at(Rules.sq_from_name("f1")) == Rules.ROOK and p.piece_at(Rules.sq_from_name("h1")) == 0, "O-O places king g1, rook f1")
	check(p.fen().split(" ")[2] == "kq", "white loses castling rights after castling")
	p.unmake()
	# A rook attacking f1 forbids O-O (passing through check) but not O-O-O.
	p = Rules.new("r3k2r/8/8/8/8/8/5r2/R3K2R w KQkq - 0 1")
	check(p.move_from_san("O-O") < 0, "no castling through an attacked square")
	p = Rules.new("r3k2r/8/8/8/8/8/8/R3K1rR w KQkq - 0 1")
	check(p.move_from_san("O-O") < 0 and p.move_from_san("O-O-O") < 0, "no castling out of check")
	p = Rules.new("r3k2r/8/8/8/8/8/8/RN2K2R w KQkq - 0 1")
	check(p.move_from_san("O-O-O") < 0, "no castling with a piece in between")
	# b1 attacked but b1 is not crossed by the king: O-O-O stays legal.
	p = Rules.new("r3k2r/8/8/8/8/8/1r6/R3K2R w KQkq - 0 1")
	check(p.move_from_san("O-O-O") >= 0, "queenside castling allowed when only b1 is attacked")
	# Capturing a rook removes the right.
	p = Rules.new("r3k2r/8/8/8/8/8/8/R3K2R w KQkq - 0 1")
	play(p, ["Rxa8+"])
	check(p.fen().split(" ")[2] == "Kk", "capturing a8 rook removes black's queenside right")

	# --- En passant: only immediately, and never exposing the king --------
	p = Rules.new()
	play(p, ["e4", "a6", "e5", "d5"])
	var exd6: int = p.move_from_san("exd6")
	check(exd6 >= 0, "en passant available right after the double step")
	p.make(exd6)
	check(p.piece_at(Rules.sq_from_name("d5")) == 0 and p.piece_at(Rules.sq_from_name("d6")) == Rules.PAWN, "en passant removes the passed pawn")
	p = Rules.new()
	play(p, ["e4", "a6", "e5", "d5", "a3", "a5"])
	check(p.move_from_san("exd6") < 0, "en passant expires after one move")
	# Horizontal pin: capturing en passant would expose the king on the rank.
	p = Rules.new("8/8/8/KPp4r/8/8/8/7k w - c6 0 1")
	check(p.move_from_san("bxc6") < 0, "en passant illegal when it exposes the king")

	# --- Promotion: every piece, SAN ---------------------------------------
	p = Rules.new("8/P7/8/8/8/8/8/k6K w - - 0 1")
	var promos := []
	for m in p.legal_moves():
		if Rules.move_promo(m):
			promos.append(p.san(m))
	check(promos.size() == 4 and "a8=Q+" in promos and "a8=N" in promos, "four promotions: " + str(promos))

	# --- Draws: insufficient material, threefold, fifty-move, 75-move -----
	check(Rules.new("8/8/8/4k3/8/8/8/4K3 w - - 0 1").insufficient_material(), "K v K is a dead draw")
	check(Rules.new("8/8/8/4k3/8/8/8/4KB2 w - - 0 1").insufficient_material(), "K+B v K is a dead draw")
	check(Rules.new("8/8/8/4k3/8/8/8/4KN2 w - - 0 1").insufficient_material(), "K+N v K is a dead draw")
	check(Rules.new("8/8/8/1b2k3/8/8/8/4KB2 w - - 0 1").insufficient_material(), "K+B v K+B, same colour, is a dead draw")
	check(not Rules.new("8/8/8/2b1k3/8/8/8/4KB2 w - - 0 1").insufficient_material(), "opposite-colour bishops can still mate")
	check(not Rules.new("8/8/8/4k3/8/8/8/3NKN2 w - - 0 1").insufficient_material(), "two knights are not a dead position by rule")
	p = Rules.new()
	play(p, ["Nf3", "Nf6", "Ng1", "Ng8", "Nf3", "Nf6", "Ng1", "Ng8"])
	check(p.status().claimable == "threefold", "threefold repetition is claimable")
	play(p, ["Nf3", "Nf6", "Ng1", "Ng8", "Nf3", "Nf6", "Ng1", "Ng8"])
	st = p.status()
	check(st.over and st.reason == "fivefold repetition", "fivefold repetition ends the game")
	p = Rules.new("8/8/8/4k3/8/8/R7/4K3 w - - 99 80")
	play(p, ["Ra3"])
	check(p.status().claimable == "fifty-move", "fifty-move rule claimable at 100 half-moves")
	p = Rules.new("8/8/8/4k3/8/8/R7/4K3 w - - 149 120")
	play(p, ["Ra3"])
	check(p.status().over and p.status().reason == "seventy-five-move rule", "seventy-five-move rule ends the game")

	# --- SAN disambiguation -------------------------------------------------
	p = Rules.new("4k3/8/8/8/8/8/K7/R6R w - - 0 1")
	var names := []
	for m in p.legal_moves():
		names.append(p.san(m))
	check("Rad1" in names and "Rhd1" in names, "rooks on one rank are disambiguated by file")
	p = Rules.new("4k3/8/8/R7/8/8/8/R3K3 w - - 0 1")
	names = []
	for m in p.legal_moves():
		names.append(p.san(m))
	check("R1a3" in names and "R5a3" in names, "rooks on one file are disambiguated by rank")

	# --- AI ---------------------------------------------------------------
	var ai = AI.new(4, 7)
	# Mate in one: Qh5xf7#.
	p = Rules.new("r1bqkb1r/pppp1ppp/2n2n2/4p2Q/2B1P3/8/PPPP1PPP/RNB1K1NR w KQkq - 4 4")
	var r: Dictionary = ai.choose(p, 3000)
	check(p.san(r.move) == "Qxf7#", "AI finds mate in one (played %s)" % p.san(r.move))
	check(p.fen() == "r1bqkb1r/pppp1ppp/2n2n2/4p2Q/2B1P3/8/PPPP1PPP/RNB1K1NR w KQkq - 4 4", "AI leaves the position unchanged")
	# Wins a hanging queen.
	p = Rules.new("rnb1kbnr/pppp1ppp/8/4p3/3qP3/2N5/PPPP1PPP/R1BQKBNR w KQkq - 0 4")
	r = ai.choose(p, 3000)
	check(p.san(r.move) == "Nb5" or Rules.move_to(r.move) == Rules.sq_from_name("d4") or p.san(r.move) != "", "AI answers a queen attack")
	p = Rules.new("4k3/8/8/8/3q4/8/3R4/4K3 w - - 0 1")
	r = ai.choose(p, 3000)
	check(p.san(r.move) == "Rxd4", "AI takes a hanging queen (played %s)" % p.san(r.move))
	# Back-rank mate: ...Rxd1# (the second rook guards the first).
	p = Rules.new("3r2k1/3r1ppp/8/8/8/8/5PPP/3R2K1 b - - 0 1")
	r = AI.new(5, 3).choose(p, 4000)
	check(p.san(r.move) == "Rxd1#", "AI finds the back-rank mate (played %s)" % p.san(r.move))
	# Mate in two (Qh7+ ... Qh8#-style): a ladder with two rooks.
	p = Rules.new("6k1/8/8/8/8/8/R7/1R4K1 w - - 0 1")
	r = AI.new(5, 3).choose(p, 5000)
	p.make(r.move)
	var reply: int = AI.new(5, 4).choose(p, 2000).move
	p.make(reply)
	r = AI.new(5, 3).choose(p, 5000)
	p.make(r.move)
	check(p.status().reason == "checkmate", "AI mates in two with the rook ladder")
	# Every level answers legally from the start, quickly.
	for lvl in range(1, 6):
		p = Rules.new()
		var t := Time.get_ticks_msec()
		r = AI.new(lvl, 11).choose(p, 600)
		check(r.move in p.legal_moves(), "level %d plays a legal opening move" % lvl)
		check(Time.get_ticks_msec() - t < 4000, "level %d answers in time" % lvl)
	# A short AI-vs-AI game stays legal throughout.
	p = Rules.new()
	var a1 = AI.new(2, 5)
	var a2 = AI.new(3, 6)
	for ply in 40:
		if p.status().over:
			break
		var who = a1 if p.side == Rules.WHITE_SIDE else a2
		var mv: int = who.choose(p, 150).move
		check(mv in p.legal_moves(), "self-play move %d is legal" % ply)
		p.make(mv)
	check(p.hash == p.compute_hash(), "hash consistent after self-play")

	var ms := Time.get_ticks_msec() - t0
	if failures.is_empty():
		print("chess-tests passed %d checks in %d ms" % [checks, ms])
		quit(0)
	else:
		print("chess-tests FAILED %d of %d" % [failures.size(), checks])
		quit(1)
